Niranjana Shetty SAP EWM Functional Consultant Phone number: (+91) 8792024756 Email address: niranjanashetty7954@gmail.com

Application for the post of SAP EWM Consultant

About Niranjana Shetty

Niranjana Shetty is a Mechanical Engineering Graduate, working as SAP EWM Consultant.  He has worked 2 Implementation Projects and 2 Run time projects.  He is solution-oriented SAP EWM consultant with a keen understanding of industry-specific warehouse logistics and inventory management challenges.

He has sound knowledge of the business process and best practices to configure and integrate the SAP EWM module with other functional modules.

Professional Summary

5 years of work experience in SAP EWM S/4HANA & EWM 9.5.  Good understanding of Business Process related to warehouse processes and other Inventory Management.

Demonstrated expertise in analyzing and documenting complex business requirements,   Designing and configuring SAP EWM functionalities, and leading successful system implementations.

Skilled in integration of SAP EWM with other SAP modules like PP, MM and SD enabling seamless flow of information across the organization.

Goods receipt optimization for special cases.  Key areas of expertise in Goods Receipt, Deconsolidation, Physical Inventory, Replenishment, Picking/Packing.

EWM triggered opportunistic Cross docking for outbound driven process.  Strong understanding of broad business process in the supply chain & manufacturing space, existing knowledge of the solutions that support these processes.

Knowledge on IDOCS.  Effective interpersonal skills with ability to communicate with support personnel at various organization levels.

Analyze different testing scenarios and perform testing.

Work experience

Company: Capgemini Technology Services India Limited Project: Implementation Client: Volkswagen

Role: SAP EWM Consultant Duration: Mar 2024 to till date

Responsibilities

Attended workshops to gather business requirements and mapping the system as per the business requirement.

Documented the AS-IS and TO-BE for Inbound, Outbound and Internal Processes.  Contacting the business users for requirements gathering.  Defining and Mapping the ECC & EWM warehouses.  Transfer Master Data and transactional data from ECC to EWM system.  Define EWM warehouse structure, storage types, sections and creation of bins.  Configuration of storage type search sequence and warehouse process types.

Configuration of put-away (Deconsolidation, VAS) and stock removal process through POSC.  Knowledge on configuration of packing specification.  Knowledge on warehouse monitor.  Knowledge on condition records, Replenishment and Physical inventory.  Conducting training to the team members on EWM processes.  Functional specification document preparation for custom enhancement.  Worked in the post-implementation phase to resolve the issues and stabilize the system.  Knowledge on warehouse monitor, condition records, Replenishment and Physical inventory, Yard Management, Labor management.

Worked in the post-implementation phase to support the go-live in a new warehouse.

Company: Tata Consultancy Service (Payroll: Ilabz Technology & Coventine Digital Pvt Ltd) Project: Implementation Client: Haleon

Role: SAP EWM Consultant Duration: Aug 2022 to Feb 2024

Responsibilities

Attended workshops to gather business requirements and mapping the system as per the business requirement.

Documented the AS-IS and TO-BE for Inbound, Outbound and Internal Processes.  Contacting the business users for requirements gathering.  Basic system configuration.  Defining and Mapping the ECC & EWM warehouses.  Transfer Master Data and transactional data from ECC to EWM system.  Define EWM warehouse structure and creation of bins.  Configure the use of Storage Types, Storage Sections and Activity Areas for various EWM processes.

Configuration of storage type search sequence.  Configuration of warehouse process types, Warehouse Order and Warehouse Order Creation Rules.

Configuration of put-away (Deconsolidation, VAS) and stock removal process through POSC.  Knowledge on configuration of packing specification.  Conducting training to the team members on EWM processes.

Company: Sulax Technologies Pvt Ltd Project: Runtime Client: Otis & Faiveley

Role: SAP EWM Consultant Duration: Jul 2019 – Feb 2022

Responsibilities

Responsible for handling Incidents/Service Requests.  Used Ticketing tool Service now to handle incidents.  Handled the role of primary on call support for 3 warehouses.  Worked on tickets having high priority (SLA 4 hours).  Resolving SAP operational issues related to interfaces, change management, Process change management, including optimization of business processes.

Leading customer workshops.  Perform root cause analysis on major software & application related problems.  Queue Monitor SMQ2/SMQ1.  Production support that involves end to end maintenance with time frame accordance to SLA.  Responsible for handling CRs and coordinating with Client project team.  Worked on Interface issues like EDI/IDOC.  Create documentation on new issues resolved, route cause analysis as well as troubleshooting steps attempted prior to closing or escalation incidents.

Extensively used the warehouse monitor and RF for resolving live issues.  Primarily supported the issues related to: Inbound processes – Unloading, Deconsolidation, Put away Outbound processes – Picking, packing, loading, Goods issue Internal Process (Rearrangement, Replenishment, Scrapping, Physical Inventory).

Education

 Bachelor of Engineering (Mechanical Engineering)

Percentage:72%

Moodlakatte Institute of Technology, Kundapura (VTU) [2011 – 2015]

PUC(XIISTD)

Percentage:72%

Viveka PU College, Kota [2009–2011]

SSLC(XSTD)

Percentage:84%

Govt High School, Bidkalkatte [2007–2009]

Language skills

Mother tongue(s): Kannada  Other language(s): Hindi, English

Key Strength

Ability to work equally well in a team or alone.  Ability to multi-task without losing focus.  Strong oral & written communication skill.  Easily manage complex projects without losing momentum.
